messages:
ana-support: Hi team — ACME Privacy reached out with a formal DPA deletion request. They need (1) proof records were deleted, (2) audit log export showing all API calls for project `acme-prod-42`, and (3) confirmation that customer data never left EU regions. They also requested KMS/HSM key IDs and rotation audit. They tried the export link and got a 401. Can security + eng advise next steps?

acme-privacy: thanks, we submitted via the portal earlier today. We need an export for date range 2025-11-01..2026-03-15 and a statement that model cache and logs were removed. Urgent for compliance.

leo-legal: @ana-support please confirm we have the DPA ticket ID and signed request attached. Also need a list of subprocessors involved in telemetry and backups. We'll want redacted logs (no PII) and a cover letter with timestamps and who executed the deletion.

ana-support: attaching request id: DPA-20260312-ACME (copied into the ticket). I'll attach the signed request.

mike-security: We can produce KMS key metadata (key id, creation, rotation events) and HSM attestation summary. For audit logs, we keep request logs for 180 days by default, retention policy can be overridden for enterprise. For the export: the customer 401 likely means the presigned URL was expired — what timestamp did they use?

acme-privacy: we clicked the link at 09:12 UTC, got 401. Token said "Signature has expired".

sam-eng: I'll re-run the export for project `acme-prod-42`. Quick note on storage: model KV cache is ephemeral per-host and not persisted to object store; serving traces and request logs are in our audit DB. Deletion for DPA: we can remove all persisted logs and backups related to their project, but need legal confirmation for scope.

sam-eng: (command I'll run)

```
# export audit logs for project
redwood-cli audit export --project acme-prod-42 --from 2025-11-01 --to 2026-03-15 --format ndjson --out s3://redwood-exports/dpa/DPA-20260312-ACME/
```

sam-eng: Expected output: a few NDJSON files, plus a manifest.json with checksums. I'll start now and post the signed download link.

deploy-bot: export-job started — job_id=exp-20260312-7890, started_by=sam-eng, eta ~ 12m.

mike-security: Heads up: before we hand over logs, we'll apply our standard PII redaction pipeline. Legal — do you need full IP addresses redacted or keep /24? Also confirm whether to include user identifiers that are hashed.

leo-legal: Redact full IPs. Hash user IDs. Add a cover letter that states redaction policy and who performed the operation. Also include KMS key metadata and rotation audit; we don't need raw HSM attestation blobs, just key IDs, rotation timestamps, and reference to the HSM provider attestation report.

sam-eng: Got it. Running export with redact flag.

deploy-bot: export-job completed — job_id=exp-20260312-7890, status=success, files=4, size=12.3MB, presigned_url valid_until=2026-03-15T10:12:00Z

ana-support: Sharing link with ACME now. @acme-privacy please confirm you can download within the window. If you hit 401 again, we will extend.

acme-privacy: Download succeeded, file checksum matches. We're reviewing. Quick question — is there a deletion audit that shows the actual deletion operation? We need a notarized-like statement with timestamp and identity of operator.

mike-security: We can produce a deletion audit record: who initiated deletion, job id, affected buckets/DB prefixes, and a signed timestamp. We'll include that in the cover letter and sign with our compliance key.

leo-legal: Also include a statement about data residency: confirm all persisted copies for `acme-prod-42` were in EU regions (eu-west-1, eu-central-1) and that backups were not replicated outside EU. If any infra snapshot existed outside, disclose and provide mitigation.

sam-eng: Confirmed: primary object store and audit DB for that project are EU-only. No offsite replication for that environment. I'll include exact hostgroups and snapshot IDs in the export metadata.

ana-support: Timeline for ACME: we will provide full evidence package (redacted logs, cover letter, KMS metadata, deletion audit) within 3 business days. Keeping this thread updated.

leo-legal: Thank you. Once the package is ready, I'll review for legal language and final sign-off.

acme-privacy: Received — appreciate the fast turnaround. I'll reply if we need anything else after review. :thumbsup:
